name: schedule_b
title: Schedule B — U.S. Export Classification Codes
description: Schedule B, the U.S. Census Bureau's classification of exported goods: every ten-digit commodity Census publishes, with a row for each chapter, heading and subheading its codes imply and a parent for every row. Each commodity carries Census's units of quantity, SITC, end-use, agricultural, NAICS and high-technology codes. Chapter titles and commodity text are Census's; heading and subheading text is the U.S. International Trade Commission's, from the HTS revision named in hts_release. The data is credited to the U.S. Census Bureau; Census's bulk file carries no endorsement notice.

sources.title: Schedule B 2026 — index and bulk file
HTS export — U.S. International Trade Commission (heading and subheading text)

x-joins.$comment: How to join Schedule B's NAICS codes to census/naics_2022, and how far the join reaches. It is NOT a `schema.foreignKeys` entry: a foreign key asserts that every value on the left exists on the right, and some of Census's NAICS codes on Schedule B lines are not codes of the 2022 edition. `coverage` does not live in this file: `crosswalk_join.py --write` measures it from the build and writes it into the generated `datapackage.json`.

joins.cardinality: partial — measured at build. The unmatched lines carry a code that is not a 2022 NAICS code: an industry code ending in X (33641X, 1121XX), which stands for more than one six-digit industry, or one of the codes 910000, 930000 and 990000, which Census gives to lines such as waste and scrap, used goods and chapter 98's special provisions.
joins.description: The NAICS industry Census assigns to each ten-digit commodity. Join `naics` to `naics.code` on commodity rows; both sides are text. Chapter, heading and subheading rows carry no NAICS code.
joins.evidence: Census's Schedule B export file (econcord.txt) prints a six-character NAICS code on every ten-digit line, at characters 266 to 271 of the layout Census publishes with it (exp-stru.txt, `NAICS classification`). Where the code is a 2022 national industry, it names that industry in census/naics_2022.
joins.name: naics

x-joins.verifiedBy: datasets/edgar_gleif/scripts/crosswalk_join.py — the same script both writes and checks `coverage`. Run with `--write`, right after `describe`, it measures the join above against this build's own Parquet and writes `coverage` into datapackage.json (arcform.yaml step `derive_join_coverage`). Run with no flags, it re-measures against the published objects instead and fails if the committed `coverage` disagrees.

code.description: Schedule B code, digits only: 2 (chapter), 4 (heading), 6 (subheading) or 10 (commodity) digits. Join other data on this column.

code_display.description: The code as Census prints it, with dots (0101.21.0000). For a chapter or heading, its digits; for a subheading, 0101.21.

level.description: Hierarchy level: chapter, heading, subheading or commodity (the ten-digit Schedule B number). Schedule B has no eight-digit level.

depth.description: The level's position in the ladder, from 0 for a chapter to 3 for a commodity.

parent_code.description: The code one level up, always the code's own prefix; NULL for a chapter.

description.description: The row's text. A commodity's is Census's long description and a chapter's is Census's title from the year's index page. A heading's or subheading's is USITC's text for that prefix in the HTS, except in chapter 98, where USITC's provisions are import ones, and where USITC gives the prefix no text: there it is the text of the one Census line under it, or, with several lines under it, a label such as 'Heading 9802'. text_source says which.

description_full.description: The chapter title and the text of each level above the row, then its own, joined with ' › '. Where levels take their text from the same source line, the text appears once, at the lowest of them.

release.description: Census's year folder and the date the bulk file records for its export codes file, econcord.txt, joined by '/', for example 2026/2026-07-27.

text_source.description: Whose text description is: census (a commodity's description, or a chapter title from Census's index page), usitc (USITC's HTS text for the heading or subheading, from the revision in hts_release), census_derived (a heading or subheading with exactly one Census line under it, taking that line's text, in chapter 98 or where USITC gives the prefix no text) or meridian_label (such a level with several Census lines under it, labelled by its level and code).

corpus.description: Lowercased, accent-stripped description_full: a derived free-text search field, not a source attribute.

description_short.description: Census's short description of the commodity, at most 50 characters. NULL on chapter, heading and subheading rows.

unit_1.description: Census's abbreviation for the commodity's first unit of quantity (for example KG or NO), as printed. NULL where Census prints none, and on chapter, heading and subheading rows.

unit_2.description: Census's abbreviation for the commodity's second unit of quantity, as printed. NULL where Census prints none, and on chapter, heading and subheading rows.

sitc.description: The commodity's Standard International Trade Classification, Revision 4, code, as Census prints it: five characters, with X standing for digits Census does not specify (792XX). NULL on chapter, heading and subheading rows.

end_use.description: Census's end-use classification code for the commodity, five digits, as printed. NULL on chapter, heading and subheading rows.

agricultural.description: Whether the commodity is an agricultural product, read from Census's one-character flag, which its layout calls 'Agriculture or non-agriculture product code' and prints as '0' or '1'. true is '0'. Census's layout does not say which value is which; the reading is from the data: every line of chapters 1, 2 and 4 is '0', and every line of chapter 3, fish, which USDA's definition of agricultural products leaves out, is '1'. NULL on chapter, heading and subheading rows.

naics.description: The NAICS industry Census assigns to the commodity, six characters, as printed. Joins to census/naics_2022's code; the descriptor's x-joins states how many commodity lines match. Some codes are not 2022 NAICS codes: X stands for digits Census does not specify (33641X), and 910000, 930000 and 990000 are Census's own. NULL on chapter, heading and subheading rows.

hitech.description: Census's high-technology classification for the commodity, two digits: '00' for a line outside it, otherwise the group it falls in. NULL on chapter, heading and subheading rows.

section.description: The section of the schedule the row's chapter belongs to, as a Roman numeral, from Census's index page.

hts_release.description: The USITC HTS revision whose heading and subheading text this snapshot carries (the usitc rows), for example 2026HTSRev22. The run fails if the revision's year is not the Schedule B year.
